name: rka
description: Research Knowledge Agent (RKA) — Claude Code plugin distribution from the local clone of the RKA repository. Add this marketplace via /plugin marketplace add <path-to-cloned-rka-repo>, then install the plugin via /plugin install rka@rka.

plugins.name: rka
plugins.description: Connects Claude Code to a local RKA backend for provenance-tracked research workflows. Provides ~89 RKA MCP tools, four role skills (Brain, Executor, PI, Writer), six RKA-side slash commands (/rka-status, /rka-search, /rka-pending, /rka-set-project, /rka-setup-claude-desktop, /rka-start-manuscript), and a SessionStart hook that pings the backend on every new session. The agentic-branch distribution also ships the orchestrator surface: a second MCP server (rka-orchestrator, 12 tools) that drives a LangGraph Brain⇄Executor⇄PI workflow against RKA missions AND a per-project tool-discovery onboarding wizard (Phase D — produces ~/rka-projects/{id}/tools.json + .env). Adds the orchestrator-pi skill and five orchestrator slash commands (/orchestrator-start, /orchestrator-inbox, /orchestrator-status, /orchestrator-onboard, /orchestrator-manifest). Activates when user mentions RKA, research knowledge, knowledge graph, research notes, decisions, missions, journal entries, evidence clusters, citing literature, organizing research, tracking provenance, drafting a manuscript, orchestrator, LangGraph, agentic workflows, project onboarding, or PI ratification.
